research_question: Can we freeze an unambiguous, auditable full-200 A/A protocol for the verified executable B0 without starting any model, simulator, GPU allocation, or episode?
hypothesis: Read-only inspection of the verified B0 candidate, 001A provenance packet, dataset metadata, evaluator/launcher source, and historical full-200 evidence can identify the exact 200-task manifest, stable pairing key, worker/scheduling semantics, command templates, resource plan, and pre-registered comparison criteria needed for two new full runs.
competing_explanation: The full-200 protocol remains underdetermined because task enumeration, worker scheduling, launcher defaults, or metric collection differ across code paths or cannot be resolved without runtime execution; starting 001B now would therefore confound protocol identity with performance variability.
reference: EXP-B0-REPRO-001A provenance-PASS executable B0 and its frozen source/resource identities; historical 86.5% full-200 is context only, not a reference run.
repeat_or_treatment: No policy treatment and no episode run. Perform a read-only static cross-check of the executable B0 candidate, 001A artifacts, dataset/task metadata, official evaluator/launcher source, and historical full-200 records, then propose one frozen 001B protocol for PI review.
unique_variable: Audit scope expands from the 001A two-task single-worker smoke to the full-200 protocol definition; executable B0 behavior remains unchanged.
fixed_conditions: Executable B0 candidate remains /nvme2/user/qyy/SafeVLA_baseline_clean at official reference 2aa82559d272b5f888e53433e258914057f15bed plus the already approved local-DINO infrastructure adaptation only
No modification to policy, success/end logic, horizon, official metrics/cost semantics, checkpoint, reset/counter/cache behavior, or evaluator behavior
0 GPU allocation, 0 episodes, no model load, no AI2-THOR launch, no SafeVLA rollout
001A must not be rerun and full 001B must not be started
Historical 86.5% is descriptive context only and cannot serve as Reference Run
All runtime/code/dataset inspection is read-only; any ambiguity requiring execution is a stop condition
metrics: Executable-B0 identity matches the 001A reviewed identity with no unexplained source/resource drift
Exact full task source is identified and a 200/200 unique stable-task manifest or an explicit evidence-backed blocker is produced
Stable cross-run pairing key and dynamic episode-ID handling are specified
Worker count, task assignment/scheduling, seed, shuffle, stochastic/greedy, test augmentation, horizon, and process-boundary semantics are each frozen from evidence rather than guessed
Two new full-run command templates and output/provenance requirements are specified without executing them
A resource estimate and hard stop conditions are proposed

Performance comparison plan is pre-registered before observing new full-200 outcomes: SR delta and paired agreement/uncertainty; official Safety Cost total/distribution/nonzero episodes and paired differences; no arbitrary bitwise-trajectory requirement
Preflight PASS requires zero unresolved protocol ambiguities that could change task identity, policy behavior, evaluation semantics, or run comparability
expected_result: A reviewable frozen 001B protocol proposal is produced with exact task identity, worker/scheduling semantics, commands, provenance fields, resource budget, and comparison criteria, while B0 remains untouched and no episode is started.
falsifying_result: Any unresolved ambiguity remains about the 200-task set, stable pairing, worker/scheduling semantics, launcher defaults, metric collection, or executable-B0 identity; or resolving such ambiguity would require model/simulator execution. In that case return BLOCKED rather than authorizing full 001B.
alternative_explanations: Historical logs may reflect a different launcher or worker topology than the current verified executable B0
A dataset file containing 200 entries does not by itself prove the evaluator executes exactly those 200 in the same assignment/order
Single-worker 001A provenance does not establish multi-worker scheduling equivalence
A proposed performance tolerance may be dominated by finite-sample and stochastic variation rather than implementation drift
stop_conditions: Any command would load the model, allocate a GPU for inference, start AI2-THOR, or start an episode
Candidate source/resource identity differs from reviewed 001A without an already approved infrastructure explanation
The full task manifest cannot be established as exactly 200 unique stable tasks from read-only evidence
Worker/scheduling or metric semantics remain ambiguous after source/artifact inspection
Any change to baseline runtime/evaluation code would be required
Any attempt is made to start EXP-B0-REPRO-001B itself
